title: Hezekiah
summary: King of Judah who resisted Sennacherib.
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Dates are those printed in the cited Generations books; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this person.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 752 BC (no higher-tier year available).

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 788b
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3286. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3286 = 747 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.date: Ezekia began in the very end of this yeere.
reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 788b
reign.note: Year cell "3968 3286 293". The third printed figure 293 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The cell says the reign began and prints no length.
